characters.subject: common milkweed
characters.bio: Raised them neatly. Equipped them to leave.

location.name: Sunny meadow edge in central Minnesota
Mixed conifer grove on the western Sierra Nevada

episode.subject: common milkweed
episode.title: A private moment
episode.body:
The butterfly had its whole face in my flowers. I was feeling rather special.

Then I noticed the bee on the other side. I had been flirting in several directions without moving.

proposals.visualReview: A butterfly and a bee visibly contact opposite parts of the same pink common-milkweed flower cluster. Simultaneous contact is visible; discovery, exclusivity and flirting are fiction. Neither insect is claimed to be captured or to have completed pollination.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required

episode.subject: common milkweed
episode.title: A little more
episode.body:
I had meant to give him a little nectar.

He put his mouth against my leaf. We apparently had very different ideas about how much of me was on offer.

proposals.visualReview: Striped monarch caterpillar mouth lies against the hairy common-milkweed leaf edge. Feeding is identified by the source context; a before-and-after bite or lost leaf is not claimed. The mismatch of intended generosity is fictional.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required

episode.subject: common milkweed
episode.title: Room between the bumps
episode.body:
I was pleased with how forbidding my seed pod looked. All those bumps.

The aphids settled between them. Apparently I had made a very detailed welcome mat.

proposals.visualReview: Many orange-yellow aphids cluster on the green bumpy seed pod. They are on its exterior, not imaginary young inside. The pod bumps are not asserted to be an evolved aphid defense; Delphine mistakes appearance for deterrence.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required

episode.subject: common milkweed
episode.title: Packed carefully
episode.body:
Every seed tucked against the next. No wasted space.

I would like this photograph kept for when they claim I raised them to scatter.

proposals.visualReview: Open common-milkweed pod exposes densely overlapping brown seeds in ordered rows, with pale silk still compact. A fictional parent asks for a record of the visibly ordered packing; no seed is shown flying in this image.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required

episode.subject: common milkweed
episode.title: One at a time
episode.body:
The pod opened. I had imagined a dignified departure, one seed at a time.

Now the whole family is coming out in its underwear.

proposals.visualReview: Open brown pods on standing common-milkweed stems have loose white silky seed tufts protruding in masses. Underwear is a fictional metaphor for exposed silk, not an anatomical claim. The image shows emergence from pods, not proof of airborne dispersal at this instant.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required

episode.subject: giant sequoia
episode.title: Two cones
episode.body:
They keep trying to get their arms around my trunk.

Today someone held two of my cones in one palm. I had forgotten there was a part of me they could manage.

proposals.visualReview: Two small green sequoia cones rest above a human palm while still attached to a twig. Trunk embraces are fictional remembered context. Original is only 480 by 640; hold for visual quality despite clear species and scene.
proposals.admission: hold: small original; independent lead image decision required

episode.subject: giant sequoia
episode.title: Hold still
episode.body:
Six people fussed around my base, fitting a silver wrap over the old scars.

I wanted to make it easier for them. After several centuries of practice, I was finally useful at holding still.

proposals.visualReview: Multiple firefighters in yellow work around a massive orange sequoia trunk, applying silver fire-shelter material at its base. General Sherman is the real photographed tree. The fictional narrator does not claim that historical name or quote a firefighter.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required

episode.subject: giant sequoia
episode.title: Rain from below
episode.body:
The rain arrived sideways, from a little thing on the ground.

I had spent centuries being watered from above. It was embarrassing how quickly I became attached to the hose.

proposals.visualReview: Visible sprinkler jets spray the General Grant Tree area beside hoses and protective material. Artificial watering is directly pictured; emotional attachment and long memory are fictional. No statement that the tree was otherwise untouched by fire.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required

episode.subject: giant sequoia
episode.title: The old opening
episode.body:
A firefighter stopped at the black opening in my trunk.

I was ready to be impressive about how long I had lived with it. Then he came closer, and I wanted him to be careful with me.

proposals.visualReview: A small yellow-shirted firefighter stands immediately before a huge fire-scarred trunk and dark opening. Approach and private change of feeling are fiction; source establishes post-fire hazard inspection, not medical treatment, a new wound or a spoken exchange.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required

episode.subject: saguaro cactus
episode.title: Before the arms
episode.body:
Before I had arms, snow settled on every spine.

I had spent all that time becoming difficult to touch. Each point was now holding a little more cold against me.

proposals.visualReview: Foreground unbranched saguaro bears thick snow on its crown and along ribs/spines, surrounded by snowy desert vegetation. Explicit earlier-life framing preserves Ambrose’s present branches. Emotional frustration is fiction; no damage, death, deliberate movement or claim of warmth from the snow.
proposals.admission: propose; independent lead image and prose decisions required
